_comment: Entity links of the Official Records corpus read by hand: each link below was read in its sentence (mentions), against the contents-list title (report authors) or the signature and its title line (dispatch senders), and labelled correct / wrong / uncertain. ONE reader, the builder; the sample was drawn with a seeded generator (mulberry32) from the links the build emits. Uncertain links count as wrong in the precision figures. The text excerpts are public-domain 1889 print (OR Ser. I, vol. 27) as read by OCR. Tier C links are not emitted (never a passage entity); they are labelled for information.
corpus: or27 (Official Records Ser. I vol. 27 parts 1-3)

S1.drawn_from: build with the linker before the fixes of this pass
S1.note: pairs (passage, entity) drawn uniformly within the tier

S2.drawn_from: build after the first fixes (militia, battery, Lt. Gen. ranks, author names, signers)

S3.drawn_from: not drawn: EVERY sender link added when the sender was read from the document's own lines instead of the passages' (a passage joins the lines of a paragraph, so "A. PLEASONTON," and its title line "Brigadier-General, Commanding." had become one line and no sender was read), read exhaustively
S3.note: the 5 wrong links were found by this reading and fixed (middle name and given-name check, a staff title below the rank of general, the title's rank must be the registry's rank); they are labelled wrong with fixed_after_label
